description: Raised 2026-10-25 with a_2nUsIZXNY, whose fix rests on Claude Code 2.1.310's bundled code rather than a recording: an idle compaction runs PreCompact with trigger auto. Still unrecorded: what the screen shows while it compacts, whether Muster's rules read it as working before or after the PreCompact report lands, and whether PostCompact, SessionStart (compact) or Stop follow. docs/observations/claude-code-2.1.310.md section 2 says how: a session over 100,000 tokens started with CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS=100000 and enrolled in the experiment, in a pane with extras/claude-code, left idle about 55 minutes, with Muster's run log and muster pane read around the notice.
title: Record a live idle compaction in Claude Code
